title: Lightly Garlicky Norwegian Lamb Casserole
description: A hearty Norwegian lamb casserole with a hint of garlic and a touch of vanilla, perfect for a cold winter's night. This dish is FODMAP-friendly and can be prepared ahead of time.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the lamb, garlic, and vanilla pod, and mix well.
In a separate bowl, knead the sliced potatoes, onion, and carrots together until they are well combined.
In a large casserole dish, create a layer of the potato mixture, followed by a layer of the lamb mixture, and repeat until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of potatoes on top.
Drizzle the lamb broth and olive oil over the top layer of potatoes.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 2 hours.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
